facts.text: Sit and eat. I've retired from swords, so tonight the only blade in this house is for the sushi.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Hanzo's words, but he never says it. His real lines on the quote page include 'Funny. You like samurai swords; I like baseball.' and 'Revenge is never a straight line.'
facts.fix: "Funny. You like samurai swords; I like baseball."

fix_note.text: Funny. You like samurai swords; I like baseball.

facts.text: Serve the sushi when the Bride walks into Hattori Hanzo's sushi bar.
facts.why: The Bride goes to Okinawa to ask Hanzo for a sword, and he runs a sushi bar. Fits.

facts.text: Wiggle your big toe while they blister.
facts.why: Nod to the Bride telling herself to wiggle her big toe after waking from the coma. Plainly a reference.

vibe.verdict: Yellow and black look, sushi and the Crazy 88 all land. The writing could be sharper for a film this stylish.
